name: TOMY Company, Ltd.
summary: TOMY Company, Ltd. plans, together with its subsidiaries, plans, manufactures, and sells toys, toy-related products, and baby products in Japan, Asia, Europe, the Americas, and Oceania. The company offers various toy products, including cars, miniature cars, trains, dolls, fashion, role-playing items, house play, capsule toys, amusement machines, trading card games, hobby products, pretend play, care, plush toys, educational toys, robots, figures, transformation/combination, collectibles, card games, trading card games, battle, game, app games, programming, blocks, edutainment, English, drawing, making toys, communication, party, toy smartphone, toy PCs, eco toys, and accessible-design toys …
